title: Minimize The Difference Between Target And Chosen Elements
description:
Choose exactly one value from each row of `mat`. Return the minimum possible absolute difference between the sum of chosen values and `target`.

## Examples

```text
Input: mat = [[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,9]], target = 13
Output: 0
```

```text
Input: mat = [[1],[2],[3]], target = 100
Output: 94
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= mat.length, mat[i].length <= 70`
- `1 <= mat[i][j] <= 70`
- `1 <= target <= 800`
